mode: In-memory HTML; localStorage adapter; network prohibited by environment
external_services: No live tile/geocoder verification; in-memory mode skips HTTP-only integrations

checks.test: Initial page loads without JavaScript errors; empty exports are disabled
Click plotting round-trips to the exact clicked map pixel
Individual shape/color edits work; untrusted point names remain plain text
Exact coordinate entry retains precision and point styling is independent
Size and explicit coordinate editing update the selected point
Delete, undo, and redo restore exact point data
Panning leaves exports byte-for-byte equivalent; zoom lock blocks wheel zoom
Explicit zoom changes center spacing uniformly rather than rearranging points
Actual SVG download matches every on-map displacement and contains no geographic details
Rendered SVG map transforms match canonical screen positions to subpixel precision
Actual PNG has identical dimensions, transparent edges, and exact point center colors
JSON backup and local-storage API round-trip preserve coordinates, styles, and map scale
Invalid project imports leave the current project untouched
A downloaded project can be reopened with identical content
Coordinate search navigates without adding or moving any points
Offline place search provides actionable setup guidance
Date-line neighbors render and export together without rewrapping
Oversized PNG is refused without resizing; full-scale SVG remains available
All six icon shapes export without clipping
Desktop interaction suite produces no uncaught JavaScript errors
Mobile viewport has no horizontal overflow; touch plotting and PNG download work
Single-file edition supports offline plotting/export and explains live-map setup
Corrupt local data is not silently overwritten
